info.name: VillarKlarence_GradeSystem
info.description:
UST Angelicum College - Student Grade Management System API tests.

1. Import this collection and VillarKlarence_GradeSystem.postman_environment.json.
2. Select the environment "VillarKlarence_GradeSystem - Local".
3. Start the API (https://localhost:7101) and run the whole collection in order.

Folder 00 stores the tokens; folder 01 stores createdGradeId, juanGradeId and mariaGradeId.
The demo password is a test-only credential documented in README.md.
